title: advanced reboot tests fail on non-dualtor testbeds
author: antonptashnik
body:

**Description**
Recently a GARP was enabled for advanced reboot tests https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/6968.
The corresponding fixture enabling it `run_garp_service` requires another fixture `mock_server_base_ip_addr` that was not imported. This causes all advanced reboot tests to fail with output provided below
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Take non-dualtor testbed
2. Setup t0 topo
3. Run any advanced reboot TC from platform_tests/test_advanced_reboot.py

**Describe the results you received:**
```
file /var/user/jenkins/sonic-mgmt/tests/platform_tests/test_advanced_reboot.py, line 36
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures('get_advanced_reboot')
  def test_fast_reboot(request, get_advanced_reboot, verify_dut_health,
file /var/user/jenkins/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/fixtures/ptfhost_utils.py, line 326
  @pytest.fixture(scope='module', autouse=True)
  def run_garp_service(duthost, ptfhost, tbinfo, change_mac_addresses, request):
E       fixture 'mock_server_base_ip_addr' not found
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Tests pass/fail with no code errors

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix test_advanced_reboot: re-add missing import; do not run garp/icmp-responder on single TOR
linkedPullRequests.author: vaibhavhd

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This PR fixes two recently introduced issues:

1. Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/7146 caused by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/6968
2. After merge of PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/7049 , all testcases using `get_advanced_reboot` fixture are failing due to `fixture 'get_advanced_reboot' not found`

#### How did you do it?
To fix 7146, do not run GARP service and ICMP responder for non-dualtor advanced-reboot cases. I have not added a more simple skip for non-dualtor as these services are still needed for MOCK dualtor cases which run on single TOR testbeds.

To fix 2, added a new import in the test scripts directly.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Tested on single TOR and dual TOR devices, and failures are not seen anymore.
